rules: No external asset enters Approved without a manifest entry and license evidence.
Editorial-only, non-commercial, no-derivatives, unknown-license, ripped film/game assets, and trademark/IP copies without separate clearance are blocked.
Reference-only sites may inform original production work but their images/models/audio are not imported unless separately licensed.
Attribution-required assets must carry creator/title/source/license/attribution text in this manifest.
Paid/subscription assets require proof that the project/user account actually holds the applicable game-use entitlement.
External assets may not override story/canon guards, low-spec budgets, or Unreal 4.27.2 compatibility.

providers.notes: For UE4.27 use Fab in Launcher Add to Project/Create Project/Install Plugin where applicable. In-editor Fab integration is UE5.3+.
Use only assets actually acquired/entitled for this project/account; legacy acquisitions keep their applicable legacy terms.
CC BY requires attribution; editorial/NC/ND assets are blocked for production.
Model must be embedded in the game and not exposed as an extractable/open stock asset.
Review the exact item license before acquisition; do not assume all listings permit the same game-use rights.
GDC bundles are suitable for game/media use under their bundle license; keep bundle/version evidence.
CC BY requires attribution. Prefer CC0 for low-friction production.
If used, preserve required attribution and verify the exact track license at acquisition time.
Do not ingest until the exact game-use entitlement/subscription coverage is verified.
Game licensing is available, but entitlement must be verified for the project before ingest.
Use concept art as inspiration/reference only unless the specific work is separately licensed.
Use for chronology/factual research and source pointers; do not import fair-use images/maps or copy protected text into the game.
Use for secondary research only; verify important canon facts against primary/authorized sources where practical.

Weta Workshop is a world-class design/game-development/private-commission partner, not a blanket stock-asset license for Middle-earth. Any use of project imagery/designs still requires rights clearance; Weta itself notes some project material is not its IP.
HDRIs, textures and 3D models are CC0; strong low-friction source for environments and lighting.
Materials/textures are CC0; suitable for terrain, stone, wood, plaster and environmental surfaces.
Useful for auto-rigging and animation. Game use is permitted under current terms; raw character/animation files must not be redistributed as standalone assets.
Useful for actors/motions/props and Unreal export; exact content license and any required mass-distribution rights must be verified per purchase.
Good for UI/prototyping/development assets; use item license metadata and prefer CC0 packs.

Candidate AI-assisted 3D generation source for original fantasy props/characters. Verify the plan/output terms and provenance for every generated asset before Approved; do not prompt it to reproduce protected LOTR character likenesses or copyrighted production designs.
Candidate generic 3D-model source. License varies per item; approve only assets with clear game-use rights and provenance.
Useful for original human character foundations when compatible with the project's engine/runtime pipeline. Do not use it to recreate protected actor likenesses without separate rights.
Candidate texture/material source. Verify the current per-asset/site license at acquisition time before production import.
Candidate SFX/music/image source. Verify the exact item is covered by the current Pixabay Content License and is not an embedded third-party trademark/copyright exception.
Candidate SFX source. Free/paid tiers and attribution obligations may differ; store the exact license/receipt for each used sound.
Candidate SFX source only after checking each sound's specific license. Do not assume one site-wide license.
Large sound-effects archive, but permitted uses depend on the applicable BBC/RemArc licensing terms. Do not place files in Approved solely because the project is private.
Candidate music source. License varies by track; CC0/CC BY may be usable subject to exact track terms, while NC/ND/unknown entries remain blocked.
Discovery/archive source only. Item availability does not prove reuse rights. Original LOTR soundtrack/albums or other protected recordings are not approved merely because they are hosted there.
Candidate music/SFX source. Record the exact Audio Library license/attribution requirement for every selected track.
Useful for UI/iconography. Keep required creator/license attribution and verify any icon-specific exceptions.
Useful for generic game art/audio when the exact submission license is compatible. License varies per entry.
Candidate free/paid asset marketplace. Each creator sets terms; record item/license/receipt before Approved.
Candidate game-asset marketplace. Verify the exact marketplace/item license and project-use entitlement.
Legacy Unreal Marketplace/Fab acquisitions may be valuable for UE4.27. Use only assets actually entitled to the account/project and compatible with UE4.27.
Useful for finding open-source/CC0 asset repositories and tooling. Repository visibility is not a license; verify the exact LICENSE and asset provenance.

Discovery source for artist-authored 3D/XNALara/Blender work. Do not ingest ripped/ported film or game assets merely because they are downloadable; production use requires explicit item-level reuse rights/provenance.
Discovery source for rigged/high-detail 3D work. Treat ported/ripped proprietary characters as blocked unless the uploader/rightsholder provides explicit reuse rights that cover the project.
Discovery source for rigged/high-detail 3D work. Download availability is not approval; item-level license, provenance and original-rights status must be established before production ingest.

Useful discovery source for mods, armor, weapons and environment work. Mod permissions do not automatically grant reuse of extracted source assets in another project; require author/source-rights permission per asset.
Professional marketplace source separate from ARTSTATION reference browsing. Exact listing license, entitlement, redistribution limits and UE4.27 compatibility must be reviewed before acquisition.

discovery_sources_from_programmer_messag.purpose: Persistent shortlist of asset/tool sources supplied by the project owner for future world, character, animation, audio, music and UI production.
discovery_sources_from_programmer_messag.production_rule: A source being listed here means 'remember and evaluate when useful', not automatic approval. Every external asset still needs item-level provenance/license/compatibility review before Approved.

discovery_sources_from_programmer_messag.purpose: Persistent high-fidelity character/world discovery shortlist supplied by the owner for the private interactive-film production goal.
owner_intent: Prefer cinematic-quality characters, wardrobe, weapons, creatures, architecture and environments over low-detail placeholders.
Private/non-distributed home use is the intended project context.
Exact film likeness/design references are desired as a visual target.
discovery_sources_from_programmer_messag.production_rule: Being listed means remember/search/evaluate when useful, not automatic import approval. Ripped/ported proprietary film/game assets and exact actor/film copies without explicit reuse rights remain blocked from Approved. Prefer legally reusable high-fidelity assets, original derivation, commission, or project-authored reconstruction where exact source reuse is not cleared.
discovery_sources_from_programmer_messag.pipeline_rule: Final animated characters remain skeletal FBX-only with real rig/skin/deformation; production textures use PNG/TGA; heavy runtime assets must enter through soft/asynchronous loading.
